podcast.body: The Pointer Sisters covered this song on their *Energy* album, with producer Richard Perry intentionally leaning the group more solidly toward rock. "Elsewhere on the album, Perry leaned the pointers even more solidly toward rock, with covers of Fleetwood Max hypnotized."

podcast.body: Written by Bob Welch, this fuzz rock track appeared on Fleetwood Mac's 1973 *Mystery to Me* album. It gained favor on album rock radio, indicating the band's expanding sound and appeal beyond their earlier blues rock roots. "Bob's Fuzz Rock Hypnotized, which won favor on album rock radio."
